doc.description:
live.object is used to perform operations on Live objects that have been selected using the live.path object. These operations include retrieving information on the current state of the Live API and setting values to control Live.
		
		
		Note: The Live API runs in the main thread in Live, and all messages to and from the API are automatically deferred.

methods.name: getid
methods.description: The current object's id is sent from the outlet, preceded by the word id. If there is no current object, id 0 will be sent.

methods.name: id nn
methods.description:
Operation:
				
				Sets the current object. The message has the same effect if sent to both the right or the left inlet. For clarity it is suggested to always use the right inlet to supply the object id.
				
				
				- no output -

methods.name: getpath
methods.digest: Send the canonical path of current object
methods.description:
Operation:
				
				Sends the canonical path of current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							path path 
						
						
							path live_set return_tracks 0

methods.name: gettype
methods.description:
Operation:
				
				Sends the type (a.k.a. class) of the current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							type object-type 
						
						
							type Song

methods.name: getinfo
methods.digest: Send a description of the current object
methods.description:
Operation:
				
				Sends a description of the current object.
				
				
				Output to left outlet (most lines may occur multiple times, last line is info done):
				
									
					info id nn 					
					info type object-type 					
					info description description 					
					info children list-child  object-type 					
					info child child  object-type 					
					info property property  property-type 					
					info function function 					
					info done
					
 				
				Example output:
				
									
					info id 3
					
					info type Scene
					
					info description This class represents a series of ClipSlots in Lives session view matrix
					
					info children clip_slots ClipSlot
					
					info child canonical_parent Song
					
					info property is_triggered bool
					
					info property name symbol
					
					info property tempo float
					
					info function fire
					
					info function fire_as_selected
					
					info function set_fire_button_state
					
					info done

methods.name: bang, getid
methods.digest: Sends the id of the current Live object to the outlet
methods.description:
Operation:
				
				Sends the id of the current Live object to the outlet.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							id nn 
						
						
							id 5

methods.name: call
methods.digest: Call the given function of the current object (optional parameter list)
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				function the name of the function
				
				parameter-list an optional list of parameters
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Calls the given function of the current object, optionally with a list of parameters.
				
				
				Remark:
				
				The types of the parameters are given in the Live Object Model.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							functionvalue
						
						
							get_beats_loop_length 004.00.00.000

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the list child to contain the given ids
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				list-child the name of a list child of the current object
				
				id nn... id mm  the new list of objects for the given name
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Set the list child to contain the given ids.
				
				
				Remark:
				
				Not all children can be set.
				
				
				- no output -

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the child name to point to the given child
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				child the name of a child of the current object
				
				id nn  the new child object for this name
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Set the child name to point to the given child.
				
				
				Remark:
				
				Not all children can be set.
				
				
				- no output -

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the given list property to the value list
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				list-property the name of a list property of the current object
				
				value-list the new values for the property
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Set the given list property to the value list.
				
				
				Remark:
				
				Not all properties can be set. The types of the properties are given in the Live Object Model.
				
				
				- no output -

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the value of given property of the current object
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				property the name of a single-value property of the current object
				
				value the new value for the property
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Set the value of given property of the current object.
				
				
				Remark:
				
				Not all properties can be set. The types of the properties are given in the Live Object Model.
				
				
				- no output -

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the ids of the elements of the list-child of the current object
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				list-child the name of a list-child of the current object
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Sends the ids of the elements of the list-child of the current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							list-child id nn... id mm 
						
						
							clip_slots id 4 id 5

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the id of the child of the current object
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				child the name of a child of the current object
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Sends the id of the child of the current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							child id nn 
						
						
							master_track id 10

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the list of values of given property of the current object
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				list-property the name of a list property of the current object
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Sends the list of values of given property of the current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							list-propertylist of values
						
						
							input_routings Ext. In Max Resampling 1-Audio A-Return Master No Input

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Output the value of a property of the current object
methods.description:
Arguments:
				
				property the name of a single-value property of the current object
				
				
				Operation:
				
				Sends value of given property of the current object.
				
				
				
					
						
							Outlet
						
						
							Output
						
						
							Example
						
					
					
						
							left
						
						
							propertyvalue
						
						
							name base solo 3
